# Test R1: letters specifier

except Exception as e:
    print(f'  Parse error: {e}')

    r = parse('{n:l} {n:w}', 'hello world')
    print(f'  Should have raised RepeatedNameError: {r}')
except RepeatedNameError as e:
    print(f'  RepeatedNameError raised correctly: {e}')

    print(f'  Other error: {type(e).__name__}: {e}')

print(f\"  \"name\" in r: {'name' in r}\")
print(f\"  \"hello\" in r: {'hello' in r}\")
print(f\"  42 in r: {42 in r}\")
print(f\"  0 in r: {0 in r}\")
print(f\"  1 in r: {1 in r}\")
print(f\"  2 in r: {2 in r}\")

# Test R3: brace validation

    p = Parser('{x')

    p = Parser('x}')

    p = Parser('{x} {y')

except ValueError as e:

    print(f'  ERROR: Should have raised ValueError')
except ValueError as e:
    print(f'  Correctly raised ValueError for \"{{{{x}}\": {e}')

# Valid cases should work
print()
print('Valid cases:')
try:
    p = Parser('{{hello}}')
    r = p.parse('{hello}')
    print(f'  Escaped braces: {r}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'  Error with escaped braces: {e}')

try:
    p = Parser('{name:w} hello {other:w}')
    r = p.parse('world hello foobar')
    print(f'  Normal format: {r}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'  Error with normal format: {e}')
